summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience specializing in DevOps and platform engineering. Backend engineering background with hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry), and distributed systems. Strong in production troubleshooting, cloud infrastructure automation, and reliability improvements for e-healthcare platforms. Pursuing an MSc in Software Engineering in Sweden.

description: Developed backend services and observability tooling for DIPS ASA, supporting reliable operations for 100K+ healthcare users through a client-facing team at Creative Software.
Built, tested, and deployed the C#/.NET notification framework, reducing notification delivery failures by 25% in production.
Implemented distributed-systems observability with Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, FluentBit, and Splunk, enabling monitoring and tracing across services.
Optimized PostgreSQL and OpenSearch query performance, improving search latency across high-volume production workloads.
Provisioned AWS infrastructure with Terraform (IaC) and deployed containerized services on Kubernetes via CI/CD pipelines, streamlining application releases.

Developed an administration web application and notification pipeline for a healthcare software provider using Blazor and C#, implementing user interfaces and backend integration for managing notification workflows and delivery settings.

Extended the notification delivery pipeline using C# and RabbitMQ, and built observability instrumentation with FluentBit/FluentD, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana to improve message reliability and monitoring.
Assisted in database management using PL/SQL and contributed to container orchestration via Docker and Kubernetes for deployment automation.
